description: Core capabilities for the windows that use plugin/core commands: 'main' (the retired bar, kept for window dragging) and 'panel' (the menu-bar insight panel, which calls plugin:event|listen and plugin:app|version — without listing it here those invokes are rejected by the ACL). Resize dragging is deliberately absent: windows have fixed layouts. The 'topbar' pet window only calls app commands, which are not ACL-gated, so it needs no entry.
